dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GM WT spec guide gives 'up to 220 kW' for the Standard Range pack; LT Standard Range inferred to share that pack (not stated by any cited page). Corrects the earlier 350 kW value (Max pack).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GM WT spec guide lists the Standard Range pack as '475 volt' (max charge voltage, mapped to 400v class); LT Standard Range inferred to share the pack. Corrects the earlier 800v value (Max pack).

chemistry.notes: thinkEV lists NMC for the 2026 Silverado EV (model level); InsideEVs also describes the Silverado pack as NMC pouch cells. Not trim-specific.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated (owner to confirm the scaling basis): LT Standard Range inferred to share the 14-module WT Standard Range pack (no cited page says so; EPA 283 mi vs WT 286 mi). GM spec guide gives no kWh; 204 kWh usable (24-module pack, InsideEVs) x 14/24 = 119.

supercharger_access.notes: Quick web lookup. Canadian article (Sept 2024) on the GM NACS adapter for Canadian owners of Blazer EV, Equinox EV, Silverado EV and LYRIQ. Says nothing about 2026 trim ports.

charge_port.notes: Article: 2027 gets NACS instead of the CCS1 used in the 2024-2026 model years. US site; Canadian 2026 truck assumed the same (GM Canada adapter programme for Silverado EV implies CCS1).

wheels.notes: US Cars.com: Standard Range LT 18 x 8.5 in aluminum.
